digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / mirror main-branch health reporting
propositions: Cancelled scheduled runs on main render as red X on GitHub despite main being healthy, caused by concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true and a constant concurrency group key per branch.
Main-branch CI must shift from push-triggered to schedule-triggered (every 6 hours) to eliminate cancellations by construction rather than masking them.
The loss of per-commit attribution must be mitigated by publishing last-known-green SHA and a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe in the workflow summary on failure.
All GitHub Actions workflows running on main must be explicitly evaluated and have push triggers removed or constrained via branches-ignore, with gerrit-verify.yaml and reconcilers left untouched.
Pre-merge gating through Gerrit Verified lane remains unaffected by the schedule-only transition; mirror CI is a safety net only.

The main-health-report job must resolve the last successful run's SHA from the Actions API with explicit auth preconditions (actions: read scope and GH_TOKEN) and degrade gracefully when the API call fails.
